question: 2025年3月份一共有多少笔订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE d.month = 3

question: 2025年2月各品牌的销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand, SUM(f.order_amount) AS total_amount FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE d.month = 2 GROUP BY p.brand

question: 华南地区销量最高的商品及其销量是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(f.order_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id WHERE r.region_name = '华南' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1

question: 铂金会员购买次数最多的品类及其订单量是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.member_level = '铂金' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2025年1月到2月，食品饮料品类的销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS total_amount FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = '食品饮料' AND f.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250228

question: 女性客户中，消费金额最高的是谁，消费金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(f.order_amount) AS total_amount FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.gender = '女' GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2025年第一季度订单量最多的省份及其订单量是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT r.province, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE d.quarter = 'Q1' GROUP BY r.province ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: 手机数码品类中，销售额最低的品牌及其销售额是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand, SUM(f.order_amount) AS total_amount FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = '手机数码' GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY total_amount ASC LIMIT 1

question: 2025年各地区的客户数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name

question: 2025年每个月的订单量是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT d.month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id GROUP BY d.month ORDER BY d.month

question: 2025年销售额超过50000元的品牌及其销售额有哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand, SUM(f.order_amount) AS total_amount FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.brand HAVING SUM(f.order_amount) > 50000

question: 2025年客单价最高的地区及其客单价是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, AVG(f.order_amount) AS avg_amount FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY avg_amount DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2025年购买过 iPhone 15 Pro 的客户有多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_name = 'iPhone 15 Pro'

question: 2025年华北地区黄金会员的订单量是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE r.region_name = '华北' AND c.member_level = '黄金'

question: 2025年各品类的平均订单金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, AVG(f.order_amount) AS avg_amount FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category

question: 2025年销售额最高的前2个品类及其销售额是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(f.order_amount) AS total_amount FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 2

question: 2025年3月销售额最低的品牌及其销售额是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand, SUM(f.order_amount) AS total_amount FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE d.month = 3 GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY total_amount ASC LIMIT 1

question: 2025年每个大区的销售额占比（0-1 小数）是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(f.order_amount) / (SELECT SUM(order_amount) FROM fact_order) AS ratio FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id GROUP BY r.region_name
